title: CADMAGEDDON: High-Fidelity CAD Reconstruction with Local Inference
abstract: arXiv:2611.22563v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: CAD practitioners often work with proprietary parts that they are unwilling to share with external services. For individuals and small companies, bringing this work in-house also requires computational resources they can afford. We introduce CADMAGEDDON, an open-source agent that reconstructs editable CAD from meshes and can run locally on single-GPU systems and current-generation laptops. The method decomposes this complex task into a chain of simple visual decisions about what to construct and what to correct. Geometric tools support precise construction, allowing the agent to focus on visual reasoning. Using the mid-sized Qwen3.8-27B model, CADMAGEDDON outperforms prior approaches, including systems based on frontier models, in reconstruction quality on all the main benchmarks. CADMAGEDDON integrates with FreeCAD, bringing its reconstructions into practitioners' existing CAD workflows. Code: https://github.com/kulibinai/cadmageddon

translated_title: CADMAGEDDON: 基于本地推理的高保真CAD重建
translated_abstract: CAD从业者经常需要处理不愿与外部服务共享的专有零件。对于个人和小型公司而言，将这项工作内部化还需要他们能够负担得起的计算资源。我们提出了CADMAGEDDON，这是一个开源智能体，可以从网格重建可编辑的CAD模型，并且可以在单GPU系统和当代笔记本电脑上本地运行。该方法将这一复杂任务分解为一系列关于构建什么和修正什么的简单视觉决策。几何工具支持精确构建，使智能体能够专注于视觉推理。使用中等规模的Qwen3.8-27B模型，CADMAGEDDON在所有主要基准测试中的重建质量均超越了先前的方法，包括基于前沿模型的系统。CADMAGEDDON与FreeCAD集成，将其重建结果无缝融入从业者现有的CAD工作流程中。
tldr: CADMAGEDDON是一个可在单GPU系统和笔记本电脑上本地运行的开源智能体，通过将CAD重建任务分解为简单视觉决策链并借助几何工具实现精确构建，使用中等规模模型在所有主要基准上取得了超越前沿模型系统的可编辑CAD重建质量。
en_tdlr: CADMAGEDDON is an open-source agent that runs locally on single-GPU systems and laptops, decomposing mesh-to-CAD reconstruction into simple visual decisions supported by geometric tools, achieving reconstruction quality that outperforms frontier-model-based systems on all major benchmarks using only a mid-sized model.
